Private Function Show(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    If IsObject(v) Then
        Show = "object"
    ElseIf IsArray(v) Then
        Show = "array"
    ElseIf IsError(v) Then
        Show = "error"
    ElseIf IsNull(v) Then
        Show = "null"
    Else
        Show = CStr(v)
    End If
End Function

Private Function Total(ByVal r As Range) As Double
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r
        Total = Total + c.Value
    Next
End Function

Private Function Names(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Cells
        Names = Names & c.Value & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function RowsOf(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Rows
        RowsOf = RowsOf & c.Address & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function ColumnsOf(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Columns
        ColumnsOf = ColumnsOf & c.Address & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function FindAll(ByVal what As Variant) As String
    Dim r As Range, first As String, guard As Long
    Set r = ActiveSheet.Cells.Find(what, LookIn:=xlValues, LookAt:=xlWhole, MatchCase:=False)
    If r Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    first = r.Address
    Do
        FindAll = FindAll & r.Address & ","
        Set r = ActiveSheet.Cells.FindNext(r)
        guard = guard + 1
    Loop While Not r Is Nothing And r.Address <> first And guard < 20
End Function

Private Function Visible(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r
        If Not c.EntireRow.Hidden Then Visible = Visible & c.Row & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function Do1(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    Do1 = "ran:" & TypeName(v)
End Function

Private Function Col(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 7
        Col = Col & ActiveSheet.Cells(i, which).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function Row1() As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 4
        Row1 = Row1 & ActiveSheet.Cells(1, i).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function ColH() As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 9
        ColH = ColH & TypeName(ActiveSheet.Cells(i, 8).Value) & ActiveSheet.Cells(i, 8).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function FillMixed() As Boolean
    With ActiveSheet
        .Range("H1").Value = "b": .Range("H2").Value = 10: .Range("H3").Value = "A": .Range("H4").Value = True: .Range("H5").Value = -1
        .Range("H6").Value = "a": .Range("H7").Formula = "=1/0": .Range("H9").Value = "2": .Range("H9").NumberFormat = "@"
    End With
    FillMixed = True
End Function

Private Function FileText() As String
    Dim line As String
    Do While Not EOF(1)
        Line Input #1, line
        FileText = FileText & line & "/"
    Loop
End Function

Private Function Show(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    If IsObject(v) Then

    ElseIf IsNull(v) Then

End Function

Private Function Total(ByVal r As Range) As Double
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r
        Total = Total + c.Value
    Next
End Function

Private Function Names(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Cells
        Names = Names & c.Value & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function RowsOf(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Rows
        RowsOf = RowsOf & c.Address & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function ColumnsOf(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Columns
        ColumnsOf = ColumnsOf & c.Address & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function FindAll(ByVal what As Variant) As String
    Dim r As Range, first As String, guard As Long

    first = r.Address

        Set r = ActiveSheet.Cells.FindNext(r)
        guard = guard + 1

Private Function Visible(ByVal r As Range) As String

    Next
End Function

Private Function Do1(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    Do1 = "ran:" & TypeName(v)

Private Function Col(ByVal which As Long) As String

Private Function Show(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    If IsObject(v) Then
        Show = "object"
    ElseIf IsArray(v) Then
        Show = "array"
    ElseIf IsError(v) Then
        Show = "error"
    ElseIf IsNull(v) Then
        Show = "null"
    Else
        Show = CStr(v)
    End If
End Function

Private Function Total(ByVal r As Range) As Double
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r
        Total = Total + c.Value
    Next
End Function

Private Function Names(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Cells
        Names = Names & c.Value & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function RowsOf(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Rows
        RowsOf = RowsOf & c.Address & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function ColumnsOf(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Columns
        ColumnsOf = ColumnsOf & c.Address & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function FindAll(ByVal what As Variant) As String
    Dim r As Range, first As String, guard As Long
    Set r = ActiveSheet.Cells.Find(what, LookIn:=xlValues, LookAt:=xlWhole, MatchCase:=False)
    If r Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    first = r.Address
    Do
        FindAll = FindAll & r.Address & ","
        Set r = ActiveSheet.Cells.FindNext(r)
        guard = guard + 1
    Loop While Not r Is Nothing And r.Address <> first And guard < 20
End Function

Private Function Visible(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r
        If Not c.EntireRow.Hidden Then Visible = Visible & c.Row & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function Do1(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    Do1 = "ran:" & TypeName(v)
End Function

Private Function Col(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 7
        Col = Col & ActiveSheet.Cells(i, which).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function Row1() As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 4
        Row1 = Row1 & ActiveSheet.Cells(1, i).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function ColH() As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 9
        ColH = ColH & TypeName(ActiveSheet.Cells(i, 8).Value) & ActiveSheet.Cells(i, 8).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function FillMixed() As Boolean
    With ActiveSheet
        .Range("H1").Value = "b": .Range("H2").Value = 10: .Range("H3").Value = "A": .Range("H4").Value = True: .Range("H5").Value = -1
        .Range("H6").Value = "a": .Range("H7").Formula = "=1/0": .Range("H9").Value = "2": .Range("H9").NumberFormat = "@"
    End With
    FillMixed = True
End Function

Private Function FileText() As String
    Dim line As String
    Do While Not EOF(1)
        Line Input #1, line
        FileText = FileText & line & "/"
    Loop
End Function

Private Function Show(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    If IsObject(v) Then
        Show = "object"
    ElseIf IsArray(v) Then
        Show = "array"
    ElseIf IsError(v) Then
        Show = "error"
    ElseIf IsNull(v) Then
        Show = "null"
    Else
        Show = CStr(v)
    End If
End Function

Private Function Total(ByVal r As Range) As Double
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r
        Total = Total + c.Value
    Next
End Function

Private Function Names(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Cells
        Names = Names & c.Value & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function RowsOf(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Rows
        RowsOf = RowsOf & c.Address & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function ColumnsOf(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Columns
        ColumnsOf = ColumnsOf & c.Address & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function FindAll(ByVal what As Variant) As String
    Dim r As Range, first As String, guard As Long
    Set r = ActiveSheet.Cells.Find(what, LookIn:=xlValues, LookAt:=xlWhole, MatchCase:=False)
    If r Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    first = r.Address
    Do
        FindAll = FindAll & r.Address & ","
        Set r = ActiveSheet.Cells.FindNext(r)
        guard = guard + 1
    Loop While Not r Is Nothing And r.Address <> first And guard < 20
End Function

Private Function Visible(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r
        If Not c.EntireRow.Hidden Then Visible = Visible & c.Row & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function Do1(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    Do1 = "ran:" & TypeName(v)
End Function

Private Function Col(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 7
        Col = Col & ActiveSheet.Cells(i, which).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function Row1() As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 4
        Row1 = Row1 & ActiveSheet.Cells(1, i).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function ColH() As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 9
        ColH = ColH & TypeName(ActiveSheet.Cells(i, 8).Value) & ActiveSheet.Cells(i, 8).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function FillMixed() As Boolean
    With ActiveSheet
        .Range("H1").Value = "b": .Range("H2").Value = 10: .Range("H3").Value = "A": .Range("H4").Value = True: .Range("H5").Value = -1
        .Range("H6").Value = "a": .Range("H7").Formula = "=1/0": .Range("H9").Value = "2": .Range("H9").NumberFormat = "@"
    End With
    FillMixed = True
End Function

Private Function FileText() As String
    Dim line As String
    Do While Not EOF(1)
        Line Input #1, line
        FileText = FileText & line & "/"
    Loop
End Function

Private Function Show(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    If IsObject(v) Then
        Show = "object"
    ElseIf IsArray(v) Then
        Show = "array"
    ElseIf IsError(v) Then
        Show = "error"
    ElseIf IsNull(v) Then
        Show = "null"
    Else
        Show = CStr(v)
    End If
End Function

Private Function Total(ByVal r As Range) As Double
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r
        Total = Total + c.Value
    Next
End Function

Private Function Names(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Cells
        Names = Names & c.Value & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function RowsOf(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Rows
        RowsOf = RowsOf & c.Address & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function ColumnsOf(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Columns
        ColumnsOf = ColumnsOf & c.Address & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function FindAll(ByVal what As Variant) As String
    Dim r As Range, first As String, guard As Long
    Set r = ActiveSheet.Cells.Find(what, LookIn:=xlValues, LookAt:=xlWhole, MatchCase:=False)
    If r Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    first = r.Address
    Do
        FindAll = FindAll & r.Address & ","
        Set r = ActiveSheet.Cells.FindNext(r)
        guard = guard + 1
    Loop While Not r Is Nothing And r.Address <> first And guard < 20
End Function

Private Function Visible(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r
        If Not c.EntireRow.Hidden Then Visible = Visible & c.Row & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function Do1(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    Do1 = "ran:" & TypeName(v)
End Function

Private Function Col(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 7
        Col = Col & ActiveSheet.Cells(i, which).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function Row1() As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 4
        Row1 = Row1 & ActiveSheet.Cells(1, i).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function ColH() As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 9
        ColH = ColH & TypeName(ActiveSheet.Cells(i, 8).Value) & ActiveSheet.Cells(i, 8).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function FillMixed() As Boolean
    With ActiveSheet
        .Range("H1").Value = "b": .Range("H2").Value = 10: .Range("H3").Value = "A": .Range("H4").Value = True: .Range("H5").Value = -1
        .Range("H6").Value = "a": .Range("H7").Formula = "=1/0": .Range("H9").Value = "2": .Range("H9").NumberFormat = "@"
    End With
    FillMixed = True
End Function

Private Function FileText() As String
    Dim line As String
    Do While Not EOF(1)
        Line Input #1, line
        FileText = FileText & line & "/"
    Loop
End Function

Private Function Show(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    If IsObject(v) Then
        Show = "object"
    ElseIf IsArray(v) Then
        Show = "array"
    ElseIf IsError(v) Then
        Show = "error"
    ElseIf IsNull(v) Then
        Show = "null"
    Else
        Show = CStr(v)
    End If
End Function

Private Function Total(ByVal r As Range) As Double
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r
        Total = Total + c.Value
    Next
End Function

Private Function Names(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Cells
        Names = Names & c.Value & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function RowsOf(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Rows
        RowsOf = RowsOf & c.Address & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function ColumnsOf(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Columns
        ColumnsOf = ColumnsOf & c.Address & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function FindAll(ByVal what As Variant) As String
    Dim r As Range, first As String, guard As Long
    Set r = ActiveSheet.Cells.Find(what, LookIn:=xlValues, LookAt:=xlWhole, MatchCase:=False)
    If r Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    first = r.Address
    Do
        FindAll = FindAll & r.Address & ","
        Set r = ActiveSheet.Cells.FindNext(r)
        guard = guard + 1
    Loop While Not r Is Nothing And r.Address <> first And guard < 20
End Function

Private Function Visible(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r
        If Not c.EntireRow.Hidden Then Visible = Visible & c.Row & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function Do1(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    Do1 = "ran:" & TypeName(v)
End Function

Private Function Col(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 7
        Col = Col & ActiveSheet.Cells(i, which).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function Row1() As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 4
        Row1 = Row1 & ActiveSheet.Cells(1, i).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function ColH() As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 9
        ColH = ColH & TypeName(ActiveSheet.Cells(i, 8).Value) & ActiveSheet.Cells(i, 8).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function FillMixed() As Boolean
    With ActiveSheet
        .Range("H1").Value = "b": .Range("H2").Value = 10: .Range("H3").Value = "A": .Range("H4").Value = True: .Range("H5").Value = -1
        .Range("H6").Value = "a": .Range("H7").Formula = "=1/0": .Range("H9").Value = "2": .Range("H9").NumberFormat = "@"
    End With
    FillMixed = True
End Function

Private Function FileText() As String
    Dim line As String
    Do While Not EOF(1)
        Line Input #1, line
        FileText = FileText & line & "/"
    Loop
End Function

probes.name: paste
probes.late_macro:
Private Function Show(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    If IsObject(v) Then
        Show = "object"
    ElseIf IsArray(v) Then
        Show = "array"
    ElseIf IsError(v) Then
        Show = "error"
    ElseIf IsNull(v) Then
        Show = "null"
    Else
        Show = CStr(v)
    End If
End Function

Private Function Total(ByVal r As Range) As Double
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r
        Total = Total + c.Value
    Next
End Function

Private Function Names(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Cells
        Names = Names & c.Value & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function RowsOf(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Rows
        RowsOf = RowsOf & c.Address & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function ColumnsOf(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Columns
        ColumnsOf = ColumnsOf & c.Address & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function FindAll(ByVal what As Variant) As String
    Dim r As Range, first As String, guard As Long
    Set r = ActiveSheet.Cells.Find(what, LookIn:=xlValues, LookAt:=xlWhole, MatchCase:=False)
    If r Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    first = r.Address
    Do
        FindAll = FindAll & r.Address & ","
        Set r = ActiveSheet.Cells.FindNext(r)
        guard = guard + 1
    Loop While Not r Is Nothing And r.Address <> first And guard < 20
End Function

Private Function Visible(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r
        If Not c.EntireRow.Hidden Then Visible = Visible & c.Row & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function Do1(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    Do1 = "ran:" & TypeName(v)
End Function

Private Function Col(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 7
        Col = Col & ActiveSheet.Cells(i, which).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function Row1() As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 4
        Row1 = Row1 & ActiveSheet.Cells(1, i).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function ColH() As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 9
        ColH = ColH & TypeName(ActiveSheet.Cells(i, 8).Value) & ActiveSheet.Cells(i, 8).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function FillMixed() As Boolean
    With ActiveSheet
        .Range("H1").Value = "b": .Range("H2").Value = 10: .Range("H3").Value = "A": .Range("H4").Value = True: .Range("H5").Value = -1
        .Range("H6").Value = "a": .Range("H7").Formula = "=1/0": .Range("H9").Value = "2": .Range("H9").NumberFormat = "@"
    End With
    FillMixed = True
End Function

Private Function FileText() As String
    Dim line As String
    Do While Not EOF(1)
        Line Input #1, line
        FileText = FileText & line & "/"
    Loop
End Function

Function Probe() As String
Dim ws As Object, s As String, v As Variant, r As Range, c As Range, i As Long, n As Long, o As Object, t As String, a As Variant, f As String
Set ws = Worksheets.Add
ws.Name = "Sweep"
ws.Activate
ws.Range("A1:D1").Value = Array("Name", "Team", "Qty", "When")

Private Function Show(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    If IsObject(v) Then
        Show = "object"
    ElseIf IsArray(v) Then
        Show = "array"
    ElseIf IsError(v) Then
        Show = "error"
    ElseIf IsNull(v) Then
        Show = "null"
    Else
        Show = CStr(v)
    End If
End Function

Private Function Total(ByVal r As Range) As Double
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r
        Total = Total + c.Value
    Next
End Function

Private Function Names(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Cells
        Names = Names & c.Value & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function RowsOf(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Rows
        RowsOf = RowsOf & c.Address & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function ColumnsOf(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Columns
        ColumnsOf = ColumnsOf & c.Address & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function FindAll(ByVal what As Variant) As String
    Dim r As Range, first As String, guard As Long
    Set r = ActiveSheet.Cells.Find(what, LookIn:=xlValues, LookAt:=xlWhole, MatchCase:=False)
    If r Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    first = r.Address
    Do
        FindAll = FindAll & r.Address & ","
        Set r = ActiveSheet.Cells.FindNext(r)
        guard = guard + 1
    Loop While Not r Is Nothing And r.Address <> first And guard < 20
End Function

Private Function Visible(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r
        If Not c.EntireRow.Hidden Then Visible = Visible & c.Row & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function Do1(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    Do1 = "ran:" & TypeName(v)
End Function

Private Function Col(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 7
        Col = Col & ActiveSheet.Cells(i, which).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function Row1() As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 4
        Row1 = Row1 & ActiveSheet.Cells(1, i).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function ColH() As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 9
        ColH = ColH & TypeName(ActiveSheet.Cells(i, 8).Value) & ActiveSheet.Cells(i, 8).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function FillMixed() As Boolean
    With ActiveSheet
        .Range("H1").Value = "b": .Range("H2").Value = 10: .Range("H3").Value = "A": .Range("H4").Value = True: .Range("H5").Value = -1
        .Range("H6").Value = "a": .Range("H7").Formula = "=1/0": .Range("H9").Value = "2": .Range("H9").NumberFormat = "@"
    End With
    FillMixed = True
End Function

Private Function FileText() As String
    Dim line As String
    Do While Not EOF(1)
        Line Input #1, line
        FileText = FileText & line & "/"
    Loop
End Function

Private Function Show(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    If IsObject(v) Then
        Show = "object"
    ElseIf IsArray(v) Then
        Show = "array"
    ElseIf IsError(v) Then
        Show = "error"
    ElseIf IsNull(v) Then
        Show = "null"
    Else
        Show = CStr(v)
    End If
End Function

Private Function Total(ByVal r As Range) As Double
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r
        Total = Total + c.Value
    Next
End Function

Private Function Names(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Cells
        Names = Names & c.Value & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function RowsOf(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Rows
        RowsOf = RowsOf & c.Address & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function ColumnsOf(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Columns
        ColumnsOf = ColumnsOf & c.Address & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function FindAll(ByVal what As Variant) As String
    Dim r As Range, first As String, guard As Long
    Set r = ActiveSheet.Cells.Find(what, LookIn:=xlValues, LookAt:=xlWhole, MatchCase:=False)
    If r Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    first = r.Address
    Do
        FindAll = FindAll & r.Address & ","
        Set r = ActiveSheet.Cells.FindNext(r)
        guard = guard + 1
    Loop While Not r Is Nothing And r.Address <> first And guard < 20
End Function

Private Function Visible(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r
        If Not c.EntireRow.Hidden Then Visible = Visible & c.Row & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function Do1(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    Do1 = "ran:" & TypeName(v)
End Function

Private Function Col(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 7
        Col = Col & ActiveSheet.Cells(i, which).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 4

    Next
End Function

    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 9

    Next
End Function

Private Function FillMixed() As Boolean

End Function

    Do While Not EOF(1)

Private Function Show(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    If IsObject(v) Then
        Show = "object"
    ElseIf IsArray(v) Then
        Show = "array"
    ElseIf IsError(v) Then
        Show = "error"
    ElseIf IsNull(v) Then
        Show = "null"
    Else
        Show = CStr(v)
    End If
End Function

Private Function Total(ByVal r As Range) As Double
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r
        Total = Total + c.Value
    Next
End Function

Private Function Names(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Cells
        Names = Names & c.Value & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function RowsOf(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Rows
        RowsOf = RowsOf & c.Address & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function ColumnsOf(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Columns
        ColumnsOf = ColumnsOf & c.Address & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function FindAll(ByVal what As Variant) As String
    Dim r As Range, first As String, guard As Long
    Set r = ActiveSheet.Cells.Find(what, LookIn:=xlValues, LookAt:=xlWhole, MatchCase:=False)
    If r Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    first = r.Address
    Do
        FindAll = FindAll & r.Address & ","
        Set r = ActiveSheet.Cells.FindNext(r)
        guard = guard + 1
    Loop While Not r Is Nothing And r.Address <> first And guard < 20
End Function

Private Function Visible(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r
        If Not c.EntireRow.Hidden Then Visible = Visible & c.Row & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function Do1(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    Do1 = "ran:" & TypeName(v)
End Function

Private Function Col(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 7
        Col = Col & ActiveSheet.Cells(i, which).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function Row1() As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 4
        Row1 = Row1 & ActiveSheet.Cells(1, i).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function ColH() As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 9
        ColH = ColH & TypeName(ActiveSheet.Cells(i, 8).Value) & ActiveSheet.Cells(i, 8).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function FillMixed() As Boolean
    With ActiveSheet
        .Range("H1").Value = "b": .Range("H2").Value = 10: .Range("H3").Value = "A": .Range("H4").Value = True: .Range("H5").Value = -1
        .Range("H6").Value = "a": .Range("H7").Formula = "=1/0": .Range("H9").Value = "2": .Range("H9").NumberFormat = "@"
    End With
    FillMixed = True
End Function

Private Function FileText() As String
    Dim line As String
    Do While Not EOF(1)
        Line Input #1, line
        FileText = FileText & line & "/"
    Loop
End Function

Private Function Show(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    If IsObject(v) Then
        Show = "object"
    ElseIf IsArray(v) Then
        Show = "array"
    ElseIf IsError(v) Then
        Show = "error"
    ElseIf IsNull(v) Then
        Show = "null"
    Else
        Show = CStr(v)
    End If
End Function

Private Function Total(ByVal r As Range) As Double
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r
        Total = Total + c.Value
    Next
End Function

Private Function Names(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Cells
        Names = Names & c.Value & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function RowsOf(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Rows
        RowsOf = RowsOf & c.Address & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function ColumnsOf(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Columns
        ColumnsOf = ColumnsOf & c.Address & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function FindAll(ByVal what As Variant) As String
    Dim r As Range, first As String, guard As Long
    Set r = ActiveSheet.Cells.Find(what, LookIn:=xlValues, LookAt:=xlWhole, MatchCase:=False)
    If r Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    first = r.Address
    Do
        FindAll = FindAll & r.Address & ","
        Set r = ActiveSheet.Cells.FindNext(r)
        guard = guard + 1
    Loop While Not r Is Nothing And r.Address <> first And guard < 20
End Function

Private Function Visible(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r
        If Not c.EntireRow.Hidden Then Visible = Visible & c.Row & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function Do1(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    Do1 = "ran:" & TypeName(v)
End Function

Private Function Col(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 7
        Col = Col & ActiveSheet.Cells(i, which).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function Row1() As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 4
        Row1 = Row1 & ActiveSheet.Cells(1, i).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 9
        ColH = ColH & TypeName(ActiveSheet.Cells(i, 8).Value) & ActiveSheet.Cells(i, 8).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function FillMixed() As Boolean

    End With
    FillMixed = True
End Function

Private Function FileText() As String
    Dim line As String
    Do While Not EOF(1)
        Line Input #1, line
        FileText = FileText & line & "/"
    Loop
End Function

    ElseIf IsError(v) Then
        Show = "error"
    ElseIf IsNull(v) Then

        Show = CStr(v)

Private Function Total(ByVal r As Range) As Double
    Dim c As Range

Private Function Names(ByVal r As Range) As String

Private Function RowsOf(ByVal r As Range) As String

Private Function Show(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    If IsObject(v) Then
        Show = "object"
    ElseIf IsArray(v) Then
        Show = "array"
    ElseIf IsError(v) Then
        Show = "error"
    ElseIf IsNull(v) Then
        Show = "null"
    Else
        Show = CStr(v)
    End If
End Function

Private Function Total(ByVal r As Range) As Double
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r
        Total = Total + c.Value
    Next
End Function

Private Function Names(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Cells
        Names = Names & c.Value & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function RowsOf(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Rows
        RowsOf = RowsOf & c.Address & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function ColumnsOf(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Columns
        ColumnsOf = ColumnsOf & c.Address & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function FindAll(ByVal what As Variant) As String
    Dim r As Range, first As String, guard As Long
    Set r = ActiveSheet.Cells.Find(what, LookIn:=xlValues, LookAt:=xlWhole, MatchCase:=False)
    If r Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    first = r.Address
    Do
        FindAll = FindAll & r.Address & ","
        Set r = ActiveSheet.Cells.FindNext(r)
        guard = guard + 1
    Loop While Not r Is Nothing And r.Address <> first And guard < 20
End Function

Private Function Visible(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r
        If Not c.EntireRow.Hidden Then Visible = Visible & c.Row & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function Do1(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    Do1 = "ran:" & TypeName(v)
End Function

Private Function Col(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 7
        Col = Col & ActiveSheet.Cells(i, which).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function Row1() As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 4
        Row1 = Row1 & ActiveSheet.Cells(1, i).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function ColH() As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 9
        ColH = ColH & TypeName(ActiveSheet.Cells(i, 8).Value) & ActiveSheet.Cells(i, 8).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function FillMixed() As Boolean
    With ActiveSheet
        .Range("H1").Value = "b": .Range("H2").Value = 10: .Range("H3").Value = "A": .Range("H4").Value = True: .Range("H5").Value = -1
        .Range("H6").Value = "a": .Range("H7").Formula = "=1/0": .Range("H9").Value = "2": .Range("H9").NumberFormat = "@"
    End With
    FillMixed = True
End Function

Private Function FileText() As String
    Dim line As String
    Do While Not EOF(1)
        Line Input #1, line
        FileText = FileText & line & "/"
    Loop
End Function

Private Function Show(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    If IsObject(v) Then
        Show = "object"
    ElseIf IsArray(v) Then
        Show = "array"
    ElseIf IsError(v) Then
        Show = "error"
    ElseIf IsNull(v) Then
        Show = "null"
    Else
        Show = CStr(v)
    End If
End Function

Private Function Total(ByVal r As Range) As Double
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r
        Total = Total + c.Value
    Next
End Function

Private Function Names(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Cells
        Names = Names & c.Value & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function RowsOf(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Rows
        RowsOf = RowsOf & c.Address & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function ColumnsOf(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Columns
        ColumnsOf = ColumnsOf & c.Address & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function FindAll(ByVal what As Variant) As String
    Dim r As Range, first As String, guard As Long
    Set r = ActiveSheet.Cells.Find(what, LookIn:=xlValues, LookAt:=xlWhole, MatchCase:=False)
    If r Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    first = r.Address
    Do
        FindAll = FindAll & r.Address & ","
        Set r = ActiveSheet.Cells.FindNext(r)
        guard = guard + 1
    Loop While Not r Is Nothing And r.Address <> first And guard < 20
End Function

Private Function Visible(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r
        If Not c.EntireRow.Hidden Then Visible = Visible & c.Row & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function Do1(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    Do1 = "ran:" & TypeName(v)
End Function

Private Function Col(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 7
        Col = Col & ActiveSheet.Cells(i, which).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function Row1() As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 4
        Row1 = Row1 & ActiveSheet.Cells(1, i).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function ColH() As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 9
        ColH = ColH & TypeName(ActiveSheet.Cells(i, 8).Value) & ActiveSheet.Cells(i, 8).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function FillMixed() As Boolean
    With ActiveSheet
        .Range("H1").Value = "b": .Range("H2").Value = 10: .Range("H3").Value = "A": .Range("H4").Value = True: .Range("H5").Value = -1
        .Range("H6").Value = "a": .Range("H7").Formula = "=1/0": .Range("H9").Value = "2": .Range("H9").NumberFormat = "@"
    End With
    FillMixed = True
End Function

Private Function FileText() As String
    Dim line As String
    Do While Not EOF(1)
        Line Input #1, line
        FileText = FileText & line & "/"
    Loop
End Function

Private Function Show(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    If IsObject(v) Then
        Show = "object"
    ElseIf IsArray(v) Then
        Show = "array"
    ElseIf IsError(v) Then
        Show = "error"
    ElseIf IsNull(v) Then
        Show = "null"
    Else
        Show = CStr(v)
    End If
End Function

Private Function Total(ByVal r As Range) As Double
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r
        Total = Total + c.Value
    Next
End Function

Private Function Names(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Cells
        Names = Names & c.Value & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function RowsOf(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Rows
        RowsOf = RowsOf & c.Address & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function ColumnsOf(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Columns
        ColumnsOf = ColumnsOf & c.Address & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function FindAll(ByVal what As Variant) As String
    Dim r As Range, first As String, guard As Long
    Set r = ActiveSheet.Cells.Find(what, LookIn:=xlValues, LookAt:=xlWhole, MatchCase:=False)
    If r Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    first = r.Address
    Do
        FindAll = FindAll & r.Address & ","
        Set r = ActiveSheet.Cells.FindNext(r)
        guard = guard + 1
    Loop While Not r Is Nothing And r.Address <> first And guard < 20
End Function

Private Function Visible(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r

Private Function Show(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    If IsObject(v) Then
        Show = "object"
    ElseIf IsArray(v) Then
        Show = "array"
    ElseIf IsError(v) Then
        Show = "error"
    ElseIf IsNull(v) Then
        Show = "null"
    Else
        Show = CStr(v)
    End If
End Function

Private Function Total(ByVal r As Range) As Double
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r
        Total = Total + c.Value
    Next
End Function

Private Function Names(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Cells
        Names = Names & c.Value & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function RowsOf(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Rows
        RowsOf = RowsOf & c.Address & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function ColumnsOf(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Columns
        ColumnsOf = ColumnsOf & c.Address & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function FindAll(ByVal what As Variant) As String
    Dim r As Range, first As String, guard As Long
    Set r = ActiveSheet.Cells.Find(what, LookIn:=xlValues, LookAt:=xlWhole, MatchCase:=False)
    If r Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    first = r.Address
    Do
        FindAll = FindAll & r.Address & ","
        Set r = ActiveSheet.Cells.FindNext(r)
        guard = guard + 1
    Loop While Not r Is Nothing And r.Address <> first And guard < 20
End Function

Private Function Visible(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r
        If Not c.EntireRow.Hidden Then Visible = Visible & c.Row & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function Do1(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    Do1 = "ran:" & TypeName(v)
End Function

Private Function Col(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 7
        Col = Col & ActiveSheet.Cells(i, which).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function Row1() As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 4
        Row1 = Row1 & ActiveSheet.Cells(1, i).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function ColH() As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 9
        ColH = ColH & TypeName(ActiveSheet.Cells(i, 8).Value) & ActiveSheet.Cells(i, 8).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function FillMixed() As Boolean
    With ActiveSheet
        .Range("H1").Value = "b": .Range("H2").Value = 10: .Range("H3").Value = "A": .Range("H4").Value = True: .Range("H5").Value = -1
        .Range("H6").Value = "a": .Range("H7").Formula = "=1/0": .Range("H9").Value = "2": .Range("H9").NumberFormat = "@"
    End With
    FillMixed = True
End Function

Private Function FileText() As String
    Dim line As String
    Do While Not EOF(1)
        Line Input #1, line
        FileText = FileText & line & "/"
    Loop
End Function

Private Function Show(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    If IsObject(v) Then
        Show = "object"
    ElseIf IsArray(v) Then
        Show = "array"
    ElseIf IsError(v) Then
        Show = "error"
    ElseIf IsNull(v) Then
        Show = "null"
    Else
        Show = CStr(v)
    End If
End Function

Private Function Total(ByVal r As Range) As Double
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r
        Total = Total + c.Value
    Next
End Function

Private Function Names(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Cells
        Names = Names & c.Value & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function RowsOf(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Rows
        RowsOf = RowsOf & c.Address & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function ColumnsOf(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Columns
        ColumnsOf = ColumnsOf & c.Address & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function FindAll(ByVal what As Variant) As String
    Dim r As Range, first As String, guard As Long
    Set r = ActiveSheet.Cells.Find(what, LookIn:=xlValues, LookAt:=xlWhole, MatchCase:=False)
    If r Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    first = r.Address
    Do
        FindAll = FindAll & r.Address & ","
        Set r = ActiveSheet.Cells.FindNext(r)
        guard = guard + 1
    Loop While Not r Is Nothing And r.Address <> first And guard < 20
End Function

Private Function Visible(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r
        If Not c.EntireRow.Hidden Then Visible = Visible & c.Row & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function Do1(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    Do1 = "ran:" & TypeName(v)
End Function

Private Function Col(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim i As Long

End Function

Private Function Show(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    If IsObject(v) Then
        Show = "object"
    ElseIf IsArray(v) Then
        Show = "array"
    ElseIf IsError(v) Then
        Show = "error"
    ElseIf IsNull(v) Then
        Show = "null"
    Else
        Show = CStr(v)
    End If
End Function

Private Function Total(ByVal r As Range) As Double
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r
        Total = Total + c.Value
    Next
End Function

Private Function Names(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Cells
        Names = Names & c.Value & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function RowsOf(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Rows
        RowsOf = RowsOf & c.Address & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function ColumnsOf(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Columns
        ColumnsOf = ColumnsOf & c.Address & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function FindAll(ByVal what As Variant) As String
    Dim r As Range, first As String, guard As Long
    Set r = ActiveSheet.Cells.Find(what, LookIn:=xlValues, LookAt:=xlWhole, MatchCase:=False)
    If r Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    first = r.Address
    Do
        FindAll = FindAll & r.Address & ","
        Set r = ActiveSheet.Cells.FindNext(r)
        guard = guard + 1
    Loop While Not r Is Nothing And r.Address <> first And guard < 20
End Function

Private Function Visible(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r
        If Not c.EntireRow.Hidden Then Visible = Visible & c.Row & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function Do1(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    Do1 = "ran:" & TypeName(v)
End Function

Private Function Col(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 7
        Col = Col & ActiveSheet.Cells(i, which).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function Row1() As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 4
        Row1 = Row1 & ActiveSheet.Cells(1, i).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function ColH() As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 9
        ColH = ColH & TypeName(ActiveSheet.Cells(i, 8).Value) & ActiveSheet.Cells(i, 8).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function FillMixed() As Boolean
    With ActiveSheet
        .Range("H1").Value = "b": .Range("H2").Value = 10: .Range("H3").Value = "A": .Range("H4").Value = True: .Range("H5").Value = -1
        .Range("H6").Value = "a": .Range("H7").Formula = "=1/0": .Range("H9").Value = "2": .Range("H9").NumberFormat = "@"
    End With
    FillMixed = True
End Function

Private Function FileText() As String
    Dim line As String
    Do While Not EOF(1)
        Line Input #1, line
        FileText = FileText & line & "/"
    Loop
End Function

Private Function Show(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    If IsObject(v) Then
        Show = "object"
    ElseIf IsArray(v) Then
        Show = "array"
    ElseIf IsError(v) Then
        Show = "error"
    ElseIf IsNull(v) Then
        Show = "null"
    Else
        Show = CStr(v)
    End If
End Function

Private Function Total(ByVal r As Range) As Double
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r
        Total = Total + c.Value
    Next
End Function

Private Function Names(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Cells
        Names = Names & c.Value & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function RowsOf(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Rows
        RowsOf = RowsOf & c.Address & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function ColumnsOf(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Columns
        ColumnsOf = ColumnsOf & c.Address & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function FindAll(ByVal what As Variant) As String
    Dim r As Range, first As String, guard As Long
    Set r = ActiveSheet.Cells.Find(what, LookIn:=xlValues, LookAt:=xlWhole, MatchCase:=False)
    If r Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    first = r.Address
    Do
        FindAll = FindAll & r.Address & ","
        Set r = ActiveSheet.Cells.FindNext(r)
        guard = guard + 1
    Loop While Not r Is Nothing And r.Address <> first And guard < 20
End Function

Private Function Visible(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r
        If Not c.EntireRow.Hidden Then Visible = Visible & c.Row & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function Do1(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    Do1 = "ran:" & TypeName(v)

Private Function Show(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    If IsObject(v) Then
        Show = "object"
    ElseIf IsArray(v) Then
        Show = "array"
    ElseIf IsError(v) Then
        Show = "error"
    ElseIf IsNull(v) Then
        Show = "null"
    Else
        Show = CStr(v)
    End If
End Function

Private Function Total(ByVal r As Range) As Double
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r
        Total = Total + c.Value
    Next
End Function

Private Function Names(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Cells
        Names = Names & c.Value & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function RowsOf(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Rows
        RowsOf = RowsOf & c.Address & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function ColumnsOf(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r.Columns
        ColumnsOf = ColumnsOf & c.Address & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function FindAll(ByVal what As Variant) As String
    Dim r As Range, first As String, guard As Long
    Set r = ActiveSheet.Cells.Find(what, LookIn:=xlValues, LookAt:=xlWhole, MatchCase:=False)
    If r Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    first = r.Address
    Do
        FindAll = FindAll & r.Address & ","
        Set r = ActiveSheet.Cells.FindNext(r)
        guard = guard + 1
    Loop While Not r Is Nothing And r.Address <> first And guard < 20
End Function

Private Function Visible(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range
    For Each c In r
        If Not c.EntireRow.Hidden Then Visible = Visible & c.Row & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function Do1(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    Do1 = "ran:" & TypeName(v)
End Function

Private Function Col(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 7
        Col = Col & ActiveSheet.Cells(i, which).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function Row1() As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 4
        Row1 = Row1 & ActiveSheet.Cells(1, i).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function ColH() As String
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 9
        ColH = ColH & TypeName(ActiveSheet.Cells(i, 8).Value) & ActiveSheet.Cells(i, 8).Text & ","
    Next
End Function

Private Function FillMixed() As Boolean
    With ActiveSheet
        .Range("H1").Value = "b": .Range("H2").Value = 10: .Range("H3").Value = "A": .Range("H4").Value = True: .Range("H5").Value = -1
        .Range("H6").Value = "a": .Range("H7").Formula = "=1/0": .Range("H9").Value = "2": .Range("H9").NumberFormat = "@"
    End With
    FillMixed = True
End Function

Private Function FileText() As String
    Dim line As String
    Do While Not EOF(1)
        Line Input #1, line
        FileText = FileText & line & "/"
    Loop
End Function
